question: Who among the following will be the 52ⁿd Chief Justice of India in May 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Justice Bhushan Ramkrishna Gavai**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Justice Bhushan Ramkrishna Gavai** is slated to become the **52nd Chief Justice of India (CJI)** in May 2025.
 
• He is currently a **judge of the Supreme Court of India**.
 
• Justice Gavai is known for his significant contributions in the field of **constitutional law** and has delivered landmark judgments during his tenure.
 
• He hails from the **state of Maharashtra** and has an extensive legal career, including serving as a judge in the **Bombay High Court** before his elevation to the Supreme Court.
 
• The appointment of the Chief Justice of India is governed by the principle of **seniority** among the judges of the Supreme Court.
 
• The tenure of each Chief Justice is typically short, as it depends on their **date of retirement**, which is fixed at the age of **65 years**.
 
• Justice Bhushan Ramkrishna Gavai will serve as the 52nd Chief Justice of India, continuing the legacy of upholding the Constitution of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Justice Pamidighantam Sri Narasimha**__

 __
 
• Justice Narasimha is a sitting judge of the **Supreme Court of India** and is considered an expert in **constitutional matters**.
 
• He was elevated to the Supreme Court in **2021** and has a distinguished career as an advocate before his judicial appointment.
 
• He is expected to serve as the **28th Chief Justice of India** in the future.
 
 
 
• **Justice Prashant Kumar Mishra**__
 __
 
• Justice Mishra is a sitting judge of the Supreme Court and previously served as the **Chief Justice of the Andhra Pradesh High Court**.
 
• He has expertise in **civil and criminal law** and has contributed to the development of jurisprudence in India.
 
 
 
• **Justice Sudhanshu Dhulia**__
 
 
• Justice Dhulia is also a sitting judge of the Supreme Court and has served as the **Chief Justice of the Gauhati High Court**.
 
• He is known for his work in the areas of **administrative law** and **environmental law**.
